summary: Session activity cancellation combined with DataConverter encoding errors causes permanent workflow failure (TMPRL1100 Non-Determinism Error) that cannot be recovered on replay. Two bugs interact: encodeArgs panics instead of gracefully failing, and handleCancelInitiatedEvent rejects Initiated state during replay.
userImpact: Users whose workflows use sessions with failing DataConverters have permanently unrecoverable workflows that cannot be recovered even after fixing the codec issue.
rootCause: Two bugs combine: (1) encodeArgs panics instead of returning error at workflow.go:943, and (2) handleCancelInitiatedEvent does not accept commandStateInitiated, causing state machine panic when ActivityTaskCancelRequested arrives during replay before CompleteSession transitions the state machine.
proposedFix: 1. Change panic(err) to return error gracefully at workflow.go:943. 2. Add commandStateInitiated to accepted states in handleCancelInitiatedEvent, consistent with PR #323 approach.
keyQuote: Every subsequent replay hits the same panic -- the workflow is permanently unrecoverable.
